run_standard_train_step: run the standard train step to execute a single training iteration with forward, loss, backward, and optimizer step
construct_sample_for_model: construct a sample dictionary from dataloader batch data for single-input and multi-input model training
compute_loss: compute the loss from model output and target, handling both scalar and composite dictionary losses
run_backward: run backward pass with zero_grad, apex or pytorch amp scaling, and optional manual gradient all-reduce
run_optimizer_step: run optimizer step with amp grad scaler for pytorch amp or native apex, and zero grads for FSDP models
